newsitem.title: USA: ICC says joint venture sees sales doubling.
newsitem.headline: ICC says joint venture sees sales doubling.

text.p: Engelhard/ICC, a joint venture of ICC Technologies Inc and Engelhard Corp, is expected to double its sales over last year, ICC said Friday.
In the second quarter ending June 30 Engelhard/ICC will achieve the highest sales volume for any three month period, with growth in system sales on an expanding backlog, ICC said in a news release.
The company's highest previous quarterly sales level was $2.9 million in the third quarter of 1996 and sales for the year totaled $10.5 million.
